findings.claim: Q3 2026 10-Q：2025 重整計畫大部分已於 2025 完成、餘下預計 2026 完成；2024 計畫預計 2026 完成；應計重整餘額 $182M（2026-09-26）；前九個月商譽減損 $3.9B
findings.excerpt: in YTD 2026, primarily relating to the 2025 Restructuring Plan, compared to $146 million in Q3 2025 and $1.8 billion in YTD 2025. Charges in Q3 2025 and YTD 2025 primarily related to the 2025 Restructuring Plan, with the remaining charges relating to the 2024 Restructuring Plan. Asset impairment charges in YTD 2026 included non-cash goodwill impairment charges of $3.9 billion.

findings.claim: Altera 51% 股權出售給 Silver Lake 已於 9/12 完成，稅前利得 $5.6B
Intel 規劃發債並動用現金回購 Apollo 持有的 Fab 34 49% 股權（約 $14.2B，新債約 $6.5B）
